Built-ins


Syntax


Print is >. Blocks are 「 」 (or { }). Assign with =. Compare with == <> < > <= >=; math is + - * / ~ ** (~ is modulo). Unused numbers 三十二–三千 are free variable names, and so are Latin or kana words. Real digits 0–9 are rejected.
